evidence.quoted_text:
require(timer["ActiveState"] in ("inactive", "failed"),
            args.phase + " left the timer activator active after the boundary")
evidence.reason: The observe check at lines 1806-1807 requires crq-tick.timer to be inactive or failed after the boundary. The harness enables the timer and the drain path only masks the service, so a user-manager restart can start the enabled timer via timers.target while the service stays masked. The observe phase then fails before the recovery checks. This is an internal inconsistency in the fence/proof; the smallest fix is to mask or disable the timer in the fence, or accept an active timer whose service is masked. No product behavior change or owner decision is needed for this test-harness repair.
